definition: Fraction of task-required functional role and relation assignments correctly grounded by the method, scored against the SET of valid GT functional assignments rather than one oracle trajectory.
scoring_rule: FAC = max over valid GT assignments phi* of (correctly grounded required slots) / (total required slots). Unary and relational slots are equally weighted atomic GT facts; the denominator is fixed by GT and never by the prediction.
